day_local: Xuska Saint Josaphat, Wadaad iyo Shahiid
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix, jacaylka Ilaah, iyo wada-jirka Ruuxa Quduuska ah ha idinla jiraan.
penitential: Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
psalm_response: Barakaysan yahay kan caawimaaddiisu tahay Ilaaha Yacquub.
homily:
Bal ka fikir adigoo daawanaya qof si taxaddar leh u xiraya xadhkaha kabahiisa, isagoo u diyaar garoobaya inuu maalin cusub u baxo. Waxaa jira xasilooni ku jirta qofka garanaya inuu meel u socdo, qofka aan degdegin, balse si kalsooni leh u tallaabsanaya. Qofkaasi wuxuu garanayaa in nolosha ay leedahay ujeeddo ka weyn waxa indhaha lagu arko. Maanta, akhriska koowaad, Bawlos wuxuu inoo sheegayaa wax ku saabsan Onesimus, wiil uu ugu yeeray 'wadnihiisa'. Bawlos wuxuu u qorayaa Filemon, isagoo ka baryaya inuu Onesimus u soo dhoweeyo, aan ahayn addoon, balse walaal. Waa codsi ku dhex milmay jacayl, oo aan ahayn amar, balse waa casuumaad lagu dhisayo qoyska Ilaah.

Injiilka maanta, Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa in Boqortooyada Ilaah aan lagu arki karin meel gaar ah oo la tilmaamo. 'Boqortooyada Ilaah waa idinka dhexdiinna,' ayuu leeyahay. Waa xaqiiqo aan mar walba dareemi karno haddii aan qalbiga u furno. Waa xaqiiqo aan maanta ku aragno nolosha Benjamin Vo. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil ay maskaxdiisu u duulaysay sidii diyaaradaha uu aadka u jeclaa. Waxaad ogtihiin inuu ahaa wiil aan kaliya ku mashquulin xisaabta iyo tiknoolajiyadda, balse ahaa wiil leh indho wax arka oo fog. Waxaad xusuusan kartaan sida uu u jeclaa inuu 'airport spotting' la sameeyo aabbihiis, isagoo si dhab ah u daawanaya diyaaradaha Boeing 737 oo kor u kacaya. Laakiin waxaa jiray wax ka sii qurux badan oo ka dhex muuqday Ben: waxay ahayd dareenkiisa ah inuu wax bixiyo. Xusuusnow markii uu ahaa 15 jir, ee uu u sheegay hooyadiis iyo aabbihiis inuu diyaar u yahay inuu dhiibo sanduuqiisa lacagta ku jirtay si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William oo xanuunsanaa? Ma uusan jebin sanduuqaydiisa, mana loo baahnayn in la jebiyo, lacagtiisana lama bixin sababtoo ah waxaa jiray caymis, laakiin dalabkaas saafi ah—wiil yar oo unprompted ah oo doonayay inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto si uu qof u caawiyo—waa muraayadda jacaylka saafi ah ee Masiixu inaga raba.

Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in afartan bilood ay yihiin kuwo culus. Waxaan rabaa inaan si daacad ah idiinla hadlo maanta. Waxaa jira saacado marka aad guriga dhexdiisa dareemaysaan in booska Ben uu yahay mid aan marnaba buuxsami karin, marka aad aragtaan sawirradiisa ama aad xasuusataan dhoola caddayntiisa markii uu ka hadlayey 'con chim airlines'. Waxaa laga yaabaa inay jiraan waqtiyo aad naftiina ku eedaysaan, ama aad is weydiisataan haddii aad wax ka qaban karteen, haddii ay jirtay meel aad ka gaabiseen. Fadlan, halkan ku hakada. Maanta, kelmadda Ilaah waxay ku leedahay qalbigaaga: Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Sida Ciise uu u sheegay kuwii weydiiyey cidda dembaabtay ee wiilka indhaha la' dhalay, 'Neither this man nor his parents.' Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah. Waxaad dareemi kartaa xorriyadda inaad baroorato adigoon dareemin dambi, waayo jacaylkaaga ayaa ahaa kan ugu weyn.

Bawlos wuxuu u sheegay Filemon in Onesimus uu isaga u ahaa 'wadnihiisa'. Sidaas oo kale, Ben wuxuu weli yahay wadnaha qoyskiinna. Wuxuu weli idinla socdaa jacaylkiisa, riyadiisa, iyo naxariistiisa. Ryan, walaal qaali ah, adiga oo maanta halkan jooga, oo xasuusanaya xiriirka adiga iyo Ben idin ka dhaxeeyay, ogow inuusan Ben kaa fogayn. Wuxuu weli ku jiraa qalbigaaga. Ha ka baqina inaad nolosha horay u qaadaan, inaad ku raaxaysataan waxyaabaha yaryar ee quruxda badan, sababtoo ah Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad faraxdaan. Wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu xasuusan jiray markii ay wada ciyaarayeen ama ay wada safrayeen. Jacaylkaagu waa mid sii socon doona oo aan dhamaanayn.

Sidee buu kanu hadda u taabanayaa qof kasta oo naga mid ah oo maanta halkan jooga? Adiga oo hooyo ah oo habeenkii ilmaynaysa, adiga oo aabbe ah oo xasuusanaya sheekooyinka uu Ben si dhab ah u dhagaysan jiray, adiga oo ah qof dareemaya inuu culaysku ka batay—ogow in Rabbigu uu kula socdo. Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ka helay irridda xigmadda iyo nabadda Jannada, halkaas oo aanay jirin ilmeyn ama daal. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in iimaankaagu uusan dhammaan doonin, maxaa yeelay Ilaah waa kan ku siinaya xoog maalin kasta. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay weligiis. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciiseow, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad ku sugan tahay Sacrament-ka ugu barakaysan. Waan ku jeclahay wax walba, waxaana rabaa inaan naftayda kugu soo dhoweeyo. Maadaama aanan hadda si dhab ah kuu qaadan karin Sacrament-ka, fadlan igu soo booqo Ruuxaaga. Waan kuu duceeyaa, waxaana naftayda u dhiibayaa gacantaada. Weligaa ha ii oggolaan inaan kaa fogaado. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin xafido, oo ha idin siiyo nabad weligeed ah. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: Rabbiyow, waxaan kuu baryaynaa Benjamin iyo dhammaan kuwii naga hormaray, inuu ku naso iftiinka iyo nabadda Masiixa.
Rabbiyow, waxaan kuu baryaynaa qoysaska iyo dadka murugaysan, inuu Ilaah u qaboojiyo qalbiyadooda oo uu siiyo rajo iyo xoog ay nolosha horay ugu sii wadaan.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Walaalkayow, jacaylkaaga waxaan ka helay farxad iyo dhiirigelin badan, waayo qalbiyada quduusiinta ayaa lagu xasiliyay adiga. In kastoo aan xaq u leeyahay inaan kugu amro waxa habboon, haddana waxaan kaa baryayaa jacayl, anoo ah Bawlos oo oday ah, haddana ah maxbuus u xiran Ciise Masiix. Waxaan kuu baryayaa wiilkayga Onesimus, oo aan aabbe u noqday xabsiga dhexdiisa. Isagu wuxuu ahaa mid aan waxtar kuu lahayn, laakiin hadda waa mid waxtar u leh adiga iyo anigaba. Waxaan kuu soo dirayaa wadnihiisa, oo aan kuu soo celinayo. Waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaan halkan ku haysto, si uu kuu matalo xabsiga dhexdiisa, laakiin ma doonayn inaan wax sameeyo adigoon ogolaan, si wanaaggaagu uusan u noqon mid qasab ah, ee uu u noqdo mid ikhtiyaari ah. Waxaa laga yaabaa inuu muddo kaa maqnaa, si aad weligaa u hesho, mar dambe oo addoon ah ma aha, balse waa walaal qaali ah, gaar ahaan aniga, laakiin adiga xitaa ka sii badan, xagga bini'aadamka iyo xagga Rabbiga. Haddii aad i u aragto saaxiib, u soo dhowee sidaad aniga ii soo dhoweyn lahayd. Haddii uu wax kugu xad-gudbay ama uu wax kugu leeyahay, aniga igu soo oog. Aniga, Bawlos, ayaan gacantayda ku qorayaa: Waan bixin doonaa. Ma doonayo inaan kuu sheego inaad naftaada igu leedahay. Haa, walaalkayow, ha iigu faa'iido Rabbiga. Wadnahayga igu xasili Masiix.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: Rabbigu wuxuu caddaalad u sameeyaa kuwa la dulmiyo, wuxuuna cunto siiyaa kuwa gaajaysan. Rabbigu wuxuu xoreeyaa maxaabiista. Barakaysan yahay kan caawimaaddiisu tahay Ilaaha Yacquub. Rabbigu wuxuu indhaha u furaa kuwa indhaha la'. Rabbigu wuxuu kor u qaadaa kuwa foorarsan; Rabbigu wuxuu jecel yahay kuwa xaqa ah. Rabbigu wuxuu dhowraa shisheeyaha. Barakaysan yahay kan caawimaaddiisu tahay Ilaaha Yacquub. Wuxuu taageeraa agoonta iyo carmalada, laakiin wuxuu fashiliyaa jidka kuwa sharka leh. Rabbigu wuxuu boqor u ahaan doonaa weligiis; Ilaahaaga, O Siiyon, qarni kasta. Alleluia.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Markii Farrisiintu ay weydiiyeen goorta Boqortooyada Ilaah ay iman doonto, Ciise wuxuu ugu jawaabay, 'Boqortooyada Ilaah lama arki karo, mana jiro qof dhihi doona, "Bal eeg, halkan ayay joogtaa," ama "halkaas ayay joogtaa." Waayo, Boqortooyada Ilaah waa idinka dhexdiinna.' Markaasuu xertiisii ku yiri, 'Waxaa iman doona maalmood aad aad u damci doontaan inaad aragtaan mid ka mid ah maalmihii Wiilka Aadanaha, laakiin ma arki doontaan. Waxaa jiri doona kuwa idin dhihi doona, "Bal eeg, halkaas ayuu joogaa," ama "Bal eeg, halkan ayuu joogaa." Ha aadin, hana raacin. Waayo, sida hillaaca u iftiimiyo cirka hal dhinac ilaa dhinaca kale, saasuu Wiilka Aadanuhu u ahaan doonaa maalintiisa. Laakiin marka hore waa inuu si weyn u xanuunsadaa oo uu qarnigan diidaa.'

day: Memorial of Saint Josaphat, Bishop and Martyr

pet_prayers.text: Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!
